I archived the "living with presence" article, clicked **Archive** in the sidebar, and there it was — its title, its Reading tag, the web address, and my note all still on the card, nothing lost. And my active bookmarks weren't sitting in that view; the archive list showed only what I'd archived. So archiving really does just move something aside with everything kept, and it stays out of the way until I go look for it. That's just what I wanted.
